description: On responsibility, example and looking after people.

items.text: A leader is one who knows the way, goes the way, and shows the way.
items.author: John C. Maxwell

translations.en: A leader is one who knows the way, goes the way, and shows the way.
translations.hi: नेता वह है जो मार्ग जानता है, उस पर चलता है और दूसरों को दिखाता है।

items.summary_1line: Know the way, walk it, then show it.
items.summary_2to3line: Leadership is three moves in sequence: clarity, personal example, and guidance. Skipping the middle one is where trust breaks.
items.bodh_3to4line: People follow conduct before they follow instructions. If you would not do it yourself, do not ask it of others. Example is the cheapest and most persuasive form of authority.

items.text: Leadership is not about being in charge. It is about taking care of those in your charge.
items.author: Simon Sinek

translations.en: Leadership is not about being in charge. It is about taking care of those in your charge.
translations.hi: नेतृत्व अधिकार का नहीं, अपने लोगों की देखभाल का नाम है।

items.summary_2to3line: Authority is a tool, not the point. The work of a leader is to make the people around them capable and secure.
items.bodh_3to4line: Reframe leadership as service. Ask what your team needs to do their best work, then remove those obstacles. People remember how you carried them, not how you directed them.

items.text: The best executive is the one who has sense enough to pick good people to do what he wants done.
items.author: Attributed to Theodore Roosevelt

translations.en: The best executive is the one who has sense enough to pick good people to do what he wants done.
translations.hi: सर्वोत्तम नेतृत्व वह है जो अपने लिए सही लोग चुनना जानता है।

items.summary_2to3line: Judgement in hiring and delegation outweighs personal heroics. Surround yourself with people better than you at their tasks.
items.bodh_3to4line: The instinct to do everything yourself is a ceiling. Select well, then step back. Your leverage is the quality of the people you trust, not the hours you personally put in.

items.text: If your actions inspire others to dream more, learn more, do more and become more, you are a leader.
items.author: Attributed to John Quincy Adams

translations.en: If your actions inspire others to dream more, learn more, do more and become more, you are a leader.
translations.hi: यदि आपके कार्य दूसरों को अधिक सपने देखने और बनने के लिए प्रेरित करें, तो आप नेता हैं।

items.summary_1line: You lead when you enlarge others.
items.summary_2to3line: Leadership shows up as growth in the people around you. If they dream and do more because of you, that is the proof.
items.bodh_3to4line: Measure your leadership by the capacity you leave behind. A good leader is not missed because everything stops without them, but because they built people who can carry on.

items.text: Management is doing things right; leadership is doing the right things.
items.author: Attributed to Peter Drucker

translations.en: Management is doing things right; leadership is doing the right things.
translations.hi: प्रबंधन सही काम करना है; नेतृत्व सही काम चुनना है।

items.summary_1line: Efficiency is management; direction is leadership.
items.summary_2to3line: You can be flawless at the wrong task. Leadership is the discipline of choosing what deserves to be done at all.
items.bodh_3to4line: Both matter, but they answer different questions. Ask 'are we climbing the right mountain?' before optimising how fast you climb. Direction first, then speed.
